meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In this meeting discussions were carried out regarding the Bill on amendment to the Goods and Services Tax Act (No. 10/2011) . In this regard, committee decided to amend sections 1 and 2 of the Bill to include “cafe” within the exemption given in section 15(h)(2) of the Act and to add a section to the Bill to amend the section. Baarashu constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to pass the bill along with the amendments brought by committee. Kendhikulhudhoo constituency member Mohamed Afoo Hamid seconded the proposal and was passed unanimously. Next on the agenda was to review Bill on amendment to the the Tourism Act (No. 2/99) . Baarashu constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to pass the bill as it was sent to the committee without any amendments and was seconded by Central Mahchangolhi constituency member Ahmed Xamyr. The proposal was passed by the majority of members vote. In addition, Bill on amendment to the Airport Taxes and Fees Act (No. 29/2016) was reviewed. Baarashu constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to pass the bill as it was sent to the committee without any amendments and was seconded by kelaa constituency member Abdulla Shareef. The proposal was passed by the majority of members vote. Furthermore, Bill on the amendment to the Export Import Act (No. 31/79) was reviewed. The committee amended Article 2 to Article 4 of the Bill. Baarashu constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to pass the bill along with the amendments brought by committee. Central Mahchangolhi constituency member Ahmed Xamyr seconded the proposal and was passed by the majority of members vote. Details of votes taken in this meeting are on “Votes” section of this page.

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: First on the agenda for today’s meeting was the appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee. Niusa Ahmed Naseer, Assistant Director General, Acounts, presided over the selection process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. Baarashu Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to elect Maamigili Constituency member Qasim Ibrahim as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Kelaa Constituency member Abdulla Shareef and passed unanimously. Baarashu Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to elect Central Fuvahmulah Constituency member Ali Fazad as the Deputy Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by North Feydhoo Constituency member Ismail Nizar and passed unanimously. Following the election, the Chair of the Committee elect Maamigili Constituency member Qasim Ibrahim presided over and opened the floor to propose the working quorum, and voting quorum. Accordingly, without any change in the statutory number of the committee Dhiggaru Constituency member Ahmed Nazim proposed to pass the voting quorum as 12 members. It was seconded by Baarashu Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau and passed unanimously. Baarashu Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau also proposed to keep the same quorum for the meetings held by the committee with other imstitutions, which was seconded by Kendhikulhudhoo Constituency member Mohamed Afoo Hamid and pass unanimously as well. Next on the agenda was finalizing deadline to complete the work of bills referred for review to the committee. Baarashu Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed, and Dhiggaru Constituency member Ahmed Nazim seconded to complete the work of the bills latest by 28 th October 2024 and passed by the majority. Furthermore, discussions were carried out regarding obtaining public comments on the bills referred to the Committee. Two proposals were submitted. 1. Baarashu Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to open for public comments latest by 28 th October 2024, 14:00 hrs, which was seconded by Funadhoo Constituency member Mohamed Mamdhooh. 2. Kendhoo Constituency member Mauroof Zakir proposed to give 5 days for public comments, which was seconded by South Hulhumale Constituency member Dr. Ahmed Shamheed. The first proposal was passed with majority of members votes. In addition, two proposals were submitted whether to obtain the relevant stakeholders comments in writing or to meet with them. 1. Baarashu Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to give the relevant stakeholders or businesses to send in their views and concerns regarding the bills during the opportunity opened for submission of public comments on the bills . It was seconded by Kelaa Constituency member Abdulla Shareef. 2. Kendhoo Constituency member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to meet and clarify information with tax-related businesses and those representing such businesses, especially those in the tourism industry (MATI, Guest House Association, Safari Boats Association, MATATO and MAYA). It was seconded by South Hulhumale Constituency member Dr. Ahmed Shamheed. The first proposal was passed with majority of members votes. Details of votes taken in this meeting are on “Votes” section of this page.
